caption: The drawing depicts a single metal tool, specifically a pair of pincers, centered on a plain, light beige background. The pincers are rendered in shades of brown and dark metallic tones, showing signs of wear and usage. The tool has two curved handles that are slightly separated, and the jaws of the pincers are closed but with a clearly defined gap in the middle. The metallic texture and the highlights indicate areas that catch the light. The name "Herman A. Steinth" and the year "1941" are handwritten in gray pencil in the bottom right corner of the paper. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition, making the tool the sole focus of the drawing.
title: Bullet Mold
